Grain incomplete.\", \"autosize\": {\"type\": \"fit\", \"contains\": \"padding\"}, \"data\": {\"url\": {\"%type%\": \"esql\", \"%context%\": true, \"%timefield%\": \"@timestamp\", \"query\": \"FROM metrics-aws.billing-default\\n| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp <= ?_tend\\n  AND aws.billing.group_definition.key == \\\"INSTANCE_TYPE\\\"\\n  AND aws.billing.group_by.INSTANCE_TYPE != \\\"NoInstanceType\\\"\\n| STATS cost = SUM(aws.billing.UnblendedCost.amount) BY itype = aws.billing.group_by.INSTANCE_TYPE\\n| SORT cost DESC\\n| LIMIT 15\"}}, \"encoding\": {\"y\": {\"field\": \"itype\", \"type\": \"nominal\", \"title\": \"Instance type\", \"sort\": \"-x\", \"axis\": {\"labelLimit\": 220, \"labelPadding\": 4, \"grid\": false}}, \"x\": {\"field\": \"cost\", \"type\": \"quantitative\", \"title\": \"Unblended USD\", \"axis\": {\"grid\": true, \"tickCount\": 5}}}, \"layer\": [{\"mark\": {\"type\": \"bar\", \"cornerRadiusEnd\": 3, \"tooltip\": true, \"height\": {\"band\": 0.72}}, \"encoding\": {\"color\": {\"field\": \"cost\", \"type\": \"quantitative\", \"scale\": {\"scheme\": \"blues\"}, \"legend\": null}, \"tooltip\": [{\"field\": \"itype\", \"type\": \"nominal\", \"title\": \"Instance type\"}, {\"field\": \"cost\", \"type\": \"quantitative\", \"title\": \"Unblended USD\", \"format\": \",.0f\"}]}}, {\"mark\": {\"type\": \"text\", \"align\": \"left\", \"baseline\": \"middle\", \"dx\": 4, \"fontSize\": 11, \"color\": \"#343741\"}, \"encoding\": {\"text\": {\"field\": \"cost\", \"type\": \"quantitative\", \"format\": \",.0f\"}}}], \"config\": {\"view\": {\"stroke\": null}, \"axis\": {\"labelFontSize\": 11, \"titleFontSize\": 12, \"domain\": false}}}"}}
